bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to apprenticeships; modifying the registered teacher apprenticeship competitive grant program.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+DIRECT FUNDING ALLOWED. +]

[+Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 16B.98, or any other law to the contrary, the commissioner of labor and industry may provide advance payments of grants to grantees under the registered teacher apprenticeship competitive grant program under Laws 2025, First Special Session chapter 6, article 2, section 2, subdivision 8, paragraph (d). To qualify for direct funding under this section, the commissioner of labor and industry must verify that a reimbursement-based model would create a financial hardship for the grantee and impede program implementation. This section expires December 31, 2027. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective July 1, 2026. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to apprenticeships; modifying the registered teacher apprenticeship competitive grant program.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. DIRECT FUNDING ALLOWED.

Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 16B.98, or any other law to the contrary, the commissioner of labor and industry may provide advance payments of grants to grantees under the registered teacher apprenticeship competitive grant program under Laws 2025, First Special Session chapter 6, article 2, section 2, subdivision 8, paragraph (d). To qualify for direct funding under this section, the commissioner of labor and industry must verify that a reimbursement-based model would create a financial hardship for the grantee and impede program implementation. This section expires December 31, 2027.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective July 1, 2026.

To qualify for direct funding under this section, the commissioner of labor and industry must verify that a reimbursement-based model would create a financial hardship for the grantee and impede program implementation. This section expires December 31, 2027.
